description:
## 1.2.0

* **Unlock developer options** (new, off by default) — reveals the hidden internal "Development" settings category.
* Compatibility is now version-agnostic (any build) and declared as an APKM split bundle, so Manager can download/patch the current mirror build (the Play build is often a step newer than mirrors).
* **Smooth gallery thumbnails** — direct MediaMetadataRetriever decode instead of a per-tile ExoPlayer pipeline.
* **Disable license check** — neutralizes PairIP so a re-signed build launches.
* **Configurable bitrate tiers** — LOW/MEDIUM/HIGH become 25/50/75% of the encoder ceiling.
